mapper.select: select (select sum(tomato_work_time) from time_doser.plan_task_history where base_user_id = #{userId} and date(creat_time) = current_date) as dayCount, (select sum(tomato_work_time) from time_doser.plan_task_history where base_user_id = #{userId} and date_format(creat_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(current_timestamp, '%Y-%m')) as weekCount, sum(tomato_work_time) as allCount from time_doser.plan_task_history where base_user_id = #{userId}
